author: OpenAI
description: We caught up with Jonathan Williams, Head of France at Legora, at RAISE Summit in Paris to discuss how AI is transforming the legal industry. As law firms and in-house legal teams embrace AI, the challenge is no longer just adopting new technology—it’s helping entire organisations adapt to a new way of working. Jonathan shares how Legora uses OpenAI models across its platform, why the pace of AI innovation continues to accelerate, and his advice for enterprise leaders navigating rapid technological change.
title: Navigating AI Transformation in the Legal Industry | Jonathan Williams, Head of France, Legora
